notes.title: Flowtris reached 600 matches!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Flowtris players. I'd like to share some awesome news. Flowtris has reached the milestone of 600 matches! Thank you so much for playing Flowtris and helping with the research.[/p][p]A new update was uploaded, including some bug fixes in surveys, high scores and other language settings. I hope the game is playable now for users that couldn't play or fill the surveys before. Please keep sharing your experiences while playing the game, through the in-game surveys.[/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes 1.0
notes.content: Added a few bug fixes in language, high score and other gameplay settings.

notes.title: Please test all three game modes and tell us how do you feel about them
notes.content: [p]Hey there, Flowtris players! It's me again, Phillip, developer of Flowtris.[/p][p]I'm glad that you are playing Flowtris, having fun, and helping with my research. It means a lot. [/p][p]Besides Flowtris' main mode, Flowtris offers two other game modes. In Flowtris' main settings, you can change its game mode. Flowtris offers three game modes, each one developed to bring a different feeling to the player. One mode is a tough challenge, while the other is more relaxing. It would really help the research if you tested the other games and told me how you felt with each game mode with the in-game surveys. The surveys are short and help a lot to understand how you feel about the game. [/p][p]Anyway, thanks for playing! ^^[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680789/7fa22709d4fb7a620db38a72d5cd8f63aff5b5e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Please help with the research
notes.content: [p]Hello, Flowtris players! My name is Phillip and I'm the developer behind Flowtris.[/p][p]I'd like to share a little about the purpose of this game: it was developed as part of my academic research in Human-Computer Interaction at the University of Rio Grande do Norte, in Brazil. The goal is to better understand player feelings when playing games.[/p][p]For this research to be successful, your participation is absolutely essential. At the end of each game, you'll see an invitation to complete a short survey. It only takes a few minutes, but the data collected is immensely valuable to the advancement of this study.[/p][p]If you've already played and skipped the survey, would you consider completing it next time? Your perspective is unique and very important.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for playing and, most importantly, for considering contributing to science! You're not just players, you're research partners.[/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Phillip[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680789/6167ec867760f6ce9a57d402fb51213ba9935231.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680789/66a4a7e1a5186b9dc31200d580d426b87ea8f56f.png"][/img][/url][/p]
